sql: /* Query 2: filter2_agg1 (player) */ SELECT nationality, SUM(olympic_gold_medals) AS sum_olympic_gold_medals FROM player WHERE nationality = 'Bahamian' AND olympic_gold_medals <= 0 GROUP BY nationality

nationality.description: nationality of the player (e.g., American, France).

olympic_gold_medals.description: number of Olympic gold medals the player has won (e.g., 3).
